data.rationale: The proposal has the right procedure, steps in order and the single package parameter, but it has small gaps: stars and open issues are noted on the Releases page instead of the repo page, it leaves out closing the GitHub tab or going Back, it doesn't name the "New note" click, and it drops the "v" prefix from the note format.
